name: Coralogix MCP
description: Query Coralogix logs, metrics and traces with DataPrime and PromQL, and manage alerts and dashboards, from AI agents via a remote MCP server, for SRE and on-call teams.

skills.name: Query with DataPrime
skills.description: Runs DataPrime queries over Coralogix logs, metrics and traces to investigate issues and perform root cause analysis.

skills.name: Query Metrics
skills.description: Runs PromQL instant and range queries on Coralogix metrics, and searches metric labels and relevant metrics.

skills.name: Manage Alerts
skills.description: Creates, updates and deletes Coralogix alerts and parsing rules, and exports them as Terraform, Kubernetes YAML or OpenAPI.

skills.name: Manage Dashboards
skills.description: Searches, creates and updates Coralogix custom dashboards and dashboard folders from an AI agent session.

skills.name: Ask Olly
skills.description: Sends natural-language investigation requests to Olly, Coralogix's observability agent, once Olly tools are enabled.
